name: label_drift_near
description: After calibration, diarization drifts and seat 1 comes back as label C, still near (-30 dB) and in long turns with 1.2 s gaps. Near voices with 3+ words on an unmapped label are seats: no crumb during the exchange, and the steer only 3.0 s after the last turn.
